verdict.rationale: Replit documents scheduled routines that turn a recurring job into something that runs on a schedule and reports back. It also documents background tasks, where Agent works independently in isolated copies of the project. Together these cover both recurring and one-off autonomous background work, but each rests on a single-sentence doc mention with no detail on setup, triggers or limits, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of routine configuration (triggers beyond schedules, run limits, failure handling, notification channels), evidence that routines run without the user present over time, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled routines work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Turn a recurring job into a routine that runs on a schedule and reports back to you.
Background tasks are separate threads where Agent works independently in isolated copies of your project.
Agent breaks work into tasks you can review, run in the background, and apply back to your main version.
